The '''Senol Forest''' was a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Innton II]]. The [[Great Cavern]], which contained the [[Defiant Core]] base, was located in the forest.<ref name="Strongholds" />
